highlights: Analyze disk usage in a file pane, with a folder tree and treemap for local and remote storage.
Browse local Git branches and commit history from a file pane.
Inspect and edit environment variables for supported scopes on Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS.
Open contextual Help with F1 and follow links between related topics.
Search Viewer and Editor syntax modes by language, alias, or extension.
Choose separate fonts and colors for Viewer, Editor, Hex Viewer, Markdown preview, Terminal, Command line, and Compare files.
See file details and counts in one pane status row, and hide File actions icons from Options.
See release highlights in the updater and reopen them from Help after installation.
